description: Kept the morning's stitch off any charge.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Told the death once, and would not add a character to it.
name: George Bryan

description: Had the rolls out, copied the cue that stands, and left the weight on them.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Said where he had heard it, and kept the parish's words from becoming doctrine.
name: John Heminges

description: Active in Came in for the afternoon play
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Waited, spoke the new cue once to the paper, and kept the old line unsaid.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Told him the end was close and the door did not need him.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Kept him on the bench and off the door.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Left the rope empty and named the laugh.
name: Will Kemp

description: Looked once, and did not follow.
name: William Shakespeare
